## Submission checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and the [Docs Index](../../docs/index.md)
      for a matching request or workaround.
- [ ] This request covers one feature only (one component, one behavior).
- [ ] I name the affected component below (proxy, launcher, tracker,
      supervisor, control panel, installer, or docs).
- [ ] I included no secrets (`<redacted>` if a log or command is shown).

## Problem

What problem does this solve, and who is affected? Describe the current
limitation or workflow pain point.

Affected component: <!-- proxy / launcher / tracker / supervisor /
control panel / installer / docs -->

## Proposal

What should change? Describe the desired behavior, including affected
components (proxy, launcher, tracker, supervisor, control panel, or docs).
Keep the scope to one feature per request.

## Acceptance criteria

How will we know this is done? List one or more checkable outcomes.

- [ ] Criterion one (for example: `panel /health` shows the new state).
- [ ] Criterion two (for example: `check_status.ps1` exits `0` after the flow).
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/index.md` link plus the affected guide) if
      user-visible behavior changes.

## Alternatives Considered

What workarounds or alternative approaches did you consider, and why are
they insufficient? If there is no alternative, write `None`.

## Additional Context

Anything else: mockups, example commands, related issues, or links to
upstream documentation. Please redact all secrets as `<redacted>`. For
background, see [Contributing](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[Support](../../SUPPORT.md), plus the glossary and security rules in
[Reference](../../docs/reference.md).

---

If this feature would help you, please star the repository to signal
interest. Maintainers use stars along with issue activity when prioritizing
the roadmap.
